channel.title: Austin County News Online - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin County News Online (austincountynewsonline.com)

item.title: Connie Drake Wins Republican Primary for Austin County Justice of the Peace, Precinct 3
item.description: Connie Drake dominates the Austin County JP3 primary results with 60.2% of votes, advancing to November as the Republican nominee for Justice of the Peace Precinct 3.

item.title: Bernice Burger Wins Republican Primary for Austin County Justice of the Peace, Precinct 4
item.description: Incumbent Bernice Burger prevails in tight Austin County JP4 primary results, securing 53.7% to advance as Republican nominee for Justice of the Peace Precinct 4—vote details and bios here.

item.title: AUSTIN COUNTY JAIL REPORT: Monday, February 23, 2026 – Sunday, March 1, 2026
item.description: AUSTIN COUNTY JAIL REPORT: Monday, February 23, 2026 - Sunday, March 1, 2026, Austin County Jail saw multiple bookings as law enforcement made arrests across the county. All individuals are considered innocent until proven guilty.

item.title: Boy Scout Troop 36 to Hold Annual Rummage Sale in Bellville
item.description: Boy Scout Troop 36 will host its annual rummage sale in Bellville this March, raising funds to support scout camp, leadership training, and other scouting activities.

item.title: Keeping Up With Your Teenager: A Parent’s Guide to Online Safety
item.description: The Austin County Sheriff’s Office is encouraging parents to learn about online risks facing teenagers through its ICAC presentation “Keeping Up With Your Teenager.”

item.title: LifeBridge Church Hosting Fundraiser Lunch to Support 2026 Mission Trips
item.description: LifeBridge Community Church in Sealy will host a drive-thru pork baked potato lunch fundraiser on March 8 to support members participating in 2026 mission trips.

item.title: Austin County 4-H Spotlights Youth Leader Presley Jacob
item.description: Austin County 4-H spotlights Presley, a young leader in the Stars and Stripes 4-H Club who is developing leadership skills while raising livestock and serving on the County Council.

item.title: Austin County 4-H Student Organizes “West End Day of Giving” Community Service Project
item.description: An Austin County 4-H student is organizing the West End Day of Giving, a community service event bringing volunteers together to help residents with small home and yard projects.

item.title: Bluebonnets and Texas Highways
item.description: Explains how bluebonnets became a common sight along Texas highways and clears up the long-standing myth that picking them is illegal.

item.title: A Short History of Aspirin
item.description: A look at the history of aspirin, from its ancient origins in willow bark remedies to becoming one of the most widely used medications in the world after Bayer patented it in 1899.
